title: Shifted events end in a cascade; m = 3 blank cells halts
text: In 1RB1LF_1LC1RB_1LE1LD_1LB0RD_1LF---_1LA0LA a right-end event with last digit b at most 10 sends the head home in the other pair grid. At the next blank stretch it runs a cascade whose result depends only on the number m of blank cells there, proved in Lean for every tape around it: m = 3 halts, m = 4 and 5 pass the head on, m of 6 or more gives a wall visit 7 cells on, m = 0 to 2 restart the recursion. All 409 halting words of at most 18 pairs halt in this cascade with m = 3, never in the first one. The first cascade always has m = 2 times the sub-visits still to come in its frame, an even number (54,597 of 54,597). The run's first five events have only even m. In the eighth event, logged cell by cell, one frame is left with exactly 5 blank cells, but its remaining sub-visits come with no event; the first 28 minutes of the return have 16,518 cascades, all with even m.
